tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ sbrul gtor cha lnga pa'i rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul bzhugs so/ 290) na mo lo ke shwa ra ya/

de nas grub thob shangs pa bka' brgyud las byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa dbon ston rin po che rkyen sgang sa chen po 'di nyid sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i skabs shig tu sbyin bdag gis nan gyis gdan drangs shing bla mas kyang bka' nan stsal ba'i ngor yon bdag gis sar zhag shas byon pas/ der zhabs tog gi rgyu rnams gsungs rabs gtsongs pa'i sku glud yin par snang ba de dag bzhes pa'i dkor gyi nyes pa'i mthus/ sngar nas thugs dam gyi yon tan dpag med yod pa thams cad 'grig cing sku lus la yang mi bde ba'i rnam pa du ma dang*/ mnal lam sogs kyang mi zad 'jig rung gi snang ba 'ba' zhig byung ba la phan thabs kyi rigs 291) ci byas kyang gsor ma chud pas/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab tshe/ 'phags pas dkor gyi nyes pa sbyongs ba'i thabs sbrul gtor gyi gdams pa 'di dngos su gnang ba bzhin mdzad pas/ bar chad de thams cad zhi zhing thugs dam gyi yon tan rnams gong 'phel du gyur pa byung ste/ des na 'di ni lhag par ding sang gi chos pa rnams la med kha med lta bur snang bas brtson 'tshal te/ de la gtor snod lnga'i dang po gnyis su ril bu nyer gcig re dang*/ 'og ma gsum du ril bu bdun re chu dang bcas pa tshul bzhin bshams nas gtor ma gzhan dang mi 'brel na skyabs sems yan lag bdun sogs sngon 'gro rnams kyang spyi ltar byas la/ dngosagazhi ni gtor snod dang po 292) de la/ badz+ra a mṛ ta 'i sngags kyi bsangs/ swā bha sa stobs pa nyid du sbyangs te/ byin rlabs ni/ rin chen gtor snod mchog tu yangs pa ru// gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dkyil// bdag gi lus las lus tshogs dpag med 'phros// bdud rtsi'i ngan song dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs// mchod rdzas kun bzang rnam 'phrul rgya cher gyur// om̐ āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog rnam gsum nyan rang byang sems dang*// gtsang ris chos skyong dkar phyogs dgon po sogs// dkar mchod la dgyes gtor mgron ma lus kun// mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung ltar bzhugs gyur// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na a wa lo ki te/

om̐ sam+bha ra am+bha ra hūm̐/ ces pa'i sngags lan nyer gcig brjod nas/ yig drug tshar nyer gcig brjod nas lhan cig tu chu thig re dang se gol re sbran nas 'bul zhing*/ mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi kyang mchod la/ bdag lus zhu ba'i mchod sprin 'di phul bas// sku gsum thugs rten dkor blud zos pa 293) dang*// bshad sgrub dge 'dun rdzas la 'phags pa'i sgrib// mkhan slob dge 'dun bka' bcags thugs skrug sogs// nyes sgrib mtha' dag 'di yis byang gyur cig sangs rgyas sku gsum mnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ ces sogs kyi bden tshig kyang brjod par bya'o/ gtor ma gnyis pa la bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin byas la/ rin chen bdud rtsi'i snod bzang 'bar ba ru// gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lngas gang*// bdag gi lus las tshogs pa dpag med 'phros// bdud rtsi'i nang song sman rag gtor tshogs kyi// mchod rdzas bla med yon tan ldan gyur cig /om̐ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can dang*// pho nya las mkhan sngags bsrungs sprul 'khor bcas// mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung ltar bzhugs gyur/ gong gi sam+bha ra'i sngags tshan nyer gcig dang yig drug chi thig se gol nyer gcig ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mchod nas/ bdag lus zhu ba'i dam rdzas 'di phul 294) bas// bla ma'i dkor dang dkyil 'khor gtor tshogs rgyu'i// dkor la 'bags dang zab mo'i dbang chos sogs// nor phyir btsongs dang bla ma mched lcam la// dam tshig nyes ltung ci bsags byang gyur cig byams pa'i thugs rje bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// gnyis med dbyings las mi 'gyur bdag bkod de// mi dmigs btang snyoms ngang du bzhugs nas byang*// gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa stsal du gsol// sogs kyis bshags pa bya'o/ ༈ snod gsum par bsangs sbyang gong ltar byas la/ gtor snod rgya chen nam mkha' mnyam pa ru// gtor ma bdud rtsi 'dod yon sna tshogs gyur// om̐ ā hūm̐/

dug gsum las dang ma rig 'khrul rtogs kyi// rgyu 'bras las sgrub gnod byed gdon bgegs rigs// snang srid kun nas gar gnas 296) ci 'dod kun// skad cig tsam la bdag tu tshogs par gyur// sam+bha ra dang yig drug chu thig le se gol bdun dang*/ mtshan bzhi yang brjod nas/ bdag lus zhu ba'i sbyin pa'i mchog rab 'di// lan chags bgegs rigs kun la bsngos pa'i mthus// dga' mgu tshim nas gzhan la gnod 'tshe sems// zhi zhing lan chags kun 'khor byang chub shog 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ sogs brjod do/ ༈ gtor snod lnga pa ni klu rgyal wa ru ṇa'i gtor ma ste/ klu gtor rgyas pa gzhan byed na 'di nyid ma byas kyang rung mod kyi/ 'di ni spyan ras gzigs dang dbon ston rin po che'i gnyis ka'i spyan sngar dam bcas pa'i chos srung yin phyir sbrul gtor gyi skabs 'dir gtong ba'i phyag srol du snang tshe/ 'dir yang bkod pa yin te/ bsangs sbyang sogs snga ma ltar las lus zhu ba de nyid mi dgos shing byin brlab ni/ rin chen gtor gzhong gtsang mdzes rgya chen du// gtor rdzas lha yi bdud rtsi rgya mtshos gtams// dkar phyogs klu rigs mnyes 297) pa'i yo byad dang*/ mchod pa'i rigs tshogs dpag med rab ldan gyur// om̐ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhārma ṇaṃ/ ā r+ya nut+pan+na twāta/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rang nyid 'phags mchog thugs rje skur gsal ba'i// mdun du pad zlar waṃ yig yongs gyur las// chu bdag kun gyi gtso bo wa ru ṇa// dkar mdzes rin chen brgyan ldan sbrul mjug can// phyag bzhi'i dang por thal sbyar g.yas 'og gis// rin chen snyed ma g.yon 'og dbyug to dang*// zhags pa snams zhing klu 'khor grangs med bcas// bdag gi mdun du gus pas 'khor par gyur// om̐ wa ru ṇa/ sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā ya dza/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ sam+bha ra dang yig drug se gol chu thig bdun/

ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cing*/ mtshan bzhi po yang bsgrag par rung ngo*/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin legs ldan pa'i// mchod gtor 'dod yon phun tshogs 'di bzhes la// sangs rgyas bstan dar chos spyod bsam dgu 'grub// char chu dus 'bab skye 'gro bde bar mdzod/ ces bsngo zhing*/ bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs sogs dang*// chos kyi sbyin pa yang bya zhing*// gtor mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam sogs rjes chog rnams ni gzhan dang mthun no/ sbrul gtor gyi rim pa 'di yang sman sgom tshul khrims bzang pos bzhed pa ltar/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis dpal ri gangs ri kyi 'dab zhol du dris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig bkra shis/
